name: Ogham Connection [Ogham]
body:
You have forged ties with the spirits of nature through the ogham, unlocking abilities granted by the goddess.

Prerequisite(s): +1 or greater Wisdom modifier.

Benefit(s): You may request the blessing of the ogham once per day, gaining a +2 bonus to a single saving throw as an immediate action. If you are in a natural area, this bonus increases to +4.

While mainly focusing on mother nature, the druid’s role can take many forms and many are heavily influenced by the world of the fey. Many of the following archetypes of from the creative juices of Aaron Hollingsworth, so enjoy.
